Fail on any violation and report the location.
Label each supported / unsupported / contradicted.
Cite the evidence id for supported claims.

few_shot_examples.input: Claim: 'Improved analyst hours by 39%.' Evidence: project metrics.
Claim: 'Improved accuracy by 63%.' Evidence: project metrics.

failure_patterns: Missed a paraphrased do-not-claim violation.
Reported a vague, locationless violation.
Passed a document with a hallucinated metric.
Gave an unsupported claim the benefit of the doubt.
